pairs.same_context: Partly: both answer a research question and communicate overall confidence.
pairs.overlap: Both restate the question, synthesize main evidence, explain disagreement/limits and provide a confidence-qualified bottom line.
decisive_differences: evidence-evidence-answer explicitly acquires and verifies research: search best evidence, grade it, synthesize effect magnitude and who it concerns, and cite every factual claim to a verified source.

scholar-evidence-synthesis does not prescribe a search. It weighs lines of evidence and may work from supplied evidence or carefully qualified general knowledge; specific nonprovided sources remain verify-before-citing and the answer ends with how to check further.
These differ in evidence acquisition/verification commitment and admissible answer status. A shared generic answer description would conceal whether a current source search happened.

items: Search sequence: reviews/meta-analyses then strong primary studies, subject to question-appropriate evidence hierarchy.
Summarize effect magnitude and applicability: how big, for whom.

Five confidence-category definitions: strong = several high-quality reviews/large studies agree; moderate = consistent with design limits; limited = few/small; conflicting = good studies disagree; insufficient = not enough research.
Grade by design/size/consistency with study-designs-and-evidence-levels handoff.
Verified sources for every factual claim and a key-sources reference list.
Explicit observational-association versus causation safeguard.
Explicit inventory of evidence types: meta-analyses, experiments, longitudinal, cross-sectional, qualitative and expert opinion.
Disagreement may reflect time periods in addition to populations/measures/methods.
Distinguish established knowledge from general knowledge and mark unprovided specific sources verify-before-citing.
How-to-check-further section with search terms and databases.
Compact supports/complicates/uncertainty output suitable for source-bound synthesis.
Full quality/integrity/privacy/copyright protections remain applicable.

routing.request: Search the current literature and tell me what research says about this intervention, with verified citations.
routing.reason: Current retrieval/verification is part of the task.

routing.request: Using only these six supplied studies, weigh the evidence, explain disagreements, and state confidence; do not search.
routing.reason: The operation is synthesis within a bounded supplied corpus.

routing.request: Explain broadly what the evidence suggests and give a search strategy; I do not need a current literature search.
routing.reason: Qualify general knowledge and specific references rather than implying fresh verification.

pairs.proposed_boundary_refinement: Make retrieval-backed research answers versus supplied-evidence/general-knowledge synthesis explicit in discovery descriptions and cross-references. This is a proposed narrower routing boundary inferred from substantive workflows, not an assertion that scholar source only permits supplied files.
pairs.merge_caution: A canonical umbrella could technically expose both branches, but that is not proof the whole workflows are duplicate under the user's strict same-task/same-context requirement. Preserve separate entrypoints here.

pairs.same_context: Yes for narrative/thematic review drafting; not for scholar's independent source-annotation deliverable.
pairs.overlap: Both organize a literature synthesis by themes/methods/chronology, compare studies, identify limits/gaps and cite sources.
decisive_differences: scholar-literature-review contains a complete annotated-bibliography mode: each source gets citation, summary, evaluation and project relevance at a course-adapted length. This is not a shortened literature review or generic duplicate paragraph.

evidence-literature-review includes source discovery/screening and review-type selection across narrative/thematic/chronological/methodological/scoping/integrative/systematic; scholar emphasizes a supplied-source synthesis matrix, justified organizing logic and optional draft prose.
Whole-skill consolidation based only on the shared literature-review heading risks burying or dropping the annotation mode and confusing source annotations with cross-source synthesis.

items: Seven review-type distinctions with systematic-review specialist handoff.
Define scope in question, years, fields and study types.
Find and screen sources via find-studies/search-strings handoffs.
Source-versus-themes extraction matrix and thematic/debate outline.
Outline first for long reviews, then full sections, in-text citations and reference list.
End with gaps, limitations and fit of user work; verified or user-supplied sources only; original paraphrased text.
Synthesis phrases highlighting divergent study results and possible design explanations.
Explicit synthesis-matrix fields: author, year, aim, method, sample, findings, limitations, theme.
Organizing logic includes theoretical organization and must be justified.
Per-theme agreement/disagreement/reasons/evidence strength and trajectory of the field.
Outline includes topic sentences; draft synthesis paragraphs only when asked; explicit gap statement; requested citation style with APA 7 default.
Independent annotated-bibliography mode: full citation; 2–3-sentence aim/method/findings summary; strengths/limitations/credibility/bias evaluation; relevance/how source will be used.
Annotation default 100–150 words, overridden by course length/style; missing citation details marked [missing: field].
Annotations require supplied/verifiable sources and encourage user's own evaluation/critical voice.
Full quality/integrity/privacy/copyright protections remain applicable.

routing.request: Write a review of this topic, first choose the review type, find/screen sources and give an outline.
routing.reason: Discovery, screening and review-type selection are primary.

routing.request: Build a synthesis matrix with aim/method/sample/limitations from these supplied papers and propose theme topic sentences.
Create a 120-word annotation for each provided source with summary, critique and relevance to my project.
routing.reason: This is its full annotated-bibliography mode and must remain discoverable.

pairs.proposed_boundary_refinement: Retain separate entrypoints and make annotation mode explicit. If future restructuring splits annotation into a dedicated source-preserving skill, reassess only the remaining review-synthesis branches after full comparison; that split is outside this review and not authorized here.
pairs.merge_caution: Preserving the original text somewhere does not make losing a distinct discoverable annotation capability acceptable. Broad topic overlap is insufficient.

pairs.same_context: Yes: analyze a literature base to identify defensible research gaps and turn them into questions/designs/contribution framing.
pairs.overlap: Both enumerate the same seven gap categories and produce evidence-linked gap/question/design outputs for the user's study. Neither contains a separate artifact mode comparable to annotated bibliography.
decisive_differences: evidence supplies discovery mechanics and recency checking; scholar supplies a structured evidence/page table plus gap/contribution wording.
These are complementary stages and presentation detail within the same gap-analysis task. They do not require different top-level user intent or artifact selection.
Source-bounded versus wider literature confirmation must remain explicit: a gap observed in supplied papers is provisional until appropriate current searching establishes its wider status.

items: Read limitations/future-research sections in recent reviews and primary studies.
Map population, setting, method and outcome; look for empty cells.
Use disagreements among good studies as an evidence-gap signal.
Check recent years to see whether the apparent gap has already been filled.
Return 3–6 gaps, each with supporting citations, why it matters, a research question and suggested design.
Gap taxonomy signals include outdated technology/conditions, absent long-term studies and real-world application testing.
Explicit table columns: gap, type, evidence (source/page), research question, suggested design.
Ready-to-adapt gap-statement paragraph and contribution-statement paragraph.
Additional taxonomy examples: small samples, self-report, missing longitudinal data, theory untested in the current context.
Explicit supplied-papers/literature-review activation and novelty/contribution requests.
Full quality/integrity/privacy/copyright protections and source-verification qualifiers.

routing.request: From these supplied papers, identify evidence-backed gaps, questions, candidate designs and a gap/contribution paragraph.
routing.primary: One consolidated gap-analysis skill, if root approves consolidation after collection gate.
routing.reason: Both entries perform the same task; preserve all source-specific method/output detail.

routing.request: Check whether this candidate gap is still open in current literature.
routing.primary: Gap analysis with actual retrieval/verification branch and relevant search specialist.
routing.reason: Source-limited observation must not be presented as universal novelty.

pairs.proposed_preserving_merge: A canonical gap-analysis entry may combine taxonomy, discovery matrix, source/page table, importance, recent-gap-closure check, questions/designs and gap/contribution statements. Retain complete source instructions/provenance and all aliases; select supplied-corpus analysis versus current literature confirmation explicitly. Do not require a live search when the user requests analysis of supplied files only; label wider novelty unresolved.
pairs.merge_caution: This is a justified candidate, not a completed or mandatory merge. No novelty claim follows from empty matrix cells, a known future-work statement or this review.

pairs.same_context: Yes: planning/executing/reporting a transparent systematic or scoping review, with protocol, search, screening, extraction, appraisal and synthesis.
pairs.overlap: Both define the same review lifecycle and offer protocol/search/screening/extraction/PRISMA outputs. The scholar description says plan while its purpose says help run; this is a phase distinction within the same reproducible-review task.
decisive_differences: evidence has more operational detail for database/grey-literature search, piloted extraction, named bias tools, pooling suitability, SWiM and certainty grading.
scholar adds review-type justification/rapid review, SPIDER, explicit eligibility dimensions, disagreement resolution and effect-measure/heterogeneity/model planning.
Both already include planning and real review conduct; no separate non-review artifact mode prevents consolidation. Preserve phase/actual-execution boundaries, field fit and user-requested scope.

items: PICO/PEO/PCC framework routing to research-question.
Protocol includes objectives, eligibility, databases/search, screening, extraction form, bias tool and synthesis plan.
Registration example OSF Registries.
Search default at least two or three databases plus grey literature/citation chaining, with dates and exact strings recorded.
Title/abstract then full-text screening, ideally two reviewers, and exclusion reasons.
Pilot extraction form and data-extraction handoff.
Design-fit bias tools named RoB 2, ROBINS-I, CASP and MMAT.
Pool only sufficiently similar studies; otherwise structured narrative synthesis with SWiM guidance.
GRADE-style certainty per outcome.
PRISMA 2020/PRISMA-ScR and exact tracked flow stages: per-database records, duplicates, screened, excluded, full-text assessed, full-text exclusions/reasons, included.
Flexible output: protocol/search strategy/eligibility table or requested written section.
Justify review type, including systematic/scoping/rapid/meta-analysis.
SPIDER framework in addition to PICO/PEO/PCC.
Explicit eligibility dimensions: population, concept, context, designs, dates and languages.
Information sources and complete search strings for each database.
Independent reviewers and disagreement-resolution procedure.
Synthesis may be narrative, thematic or meta-analytic; specify effect measure, heterogeneity and model.
Concrete protocol outline, fill-in-count PRISMA text flow template and extraction-table template.
Full quality/integrity/privacy/copyright protections and source-verification qualifiers.

routing.primary: One consolidated reproducible-review skill, if root approves consolidation after collection gate.

routing.primary: Same consolidated review workflow in execution/reporting phase.
routing.reason: Use recorded counts only; missing execution is not replaced by template numbers.

routing.request: Compute a pooled effect from these extracted studies.
routing.primary: Review workflow plus an appropriate separately reviewed meta-analysis specialist.
routing.reason: The pair plans synthesis but does not replace a full numerical meta-analysis workflow.

pairs.proposed_preserving_merge: A canonical review entry should expose protocol, execution and reporting phases; retain every question framework, eligibility field, reviewer rule, search log field, pilot extraction, bias/quality choice, similarity check, SWiM/uncertainty/PRISMA detail and template output. Tailor database counts, evidence hierarchies, bias tools and certainty methods to the field/question; they are not universally sufficient rules. Never invent counts, dual-review activity, registration or an executed search.
pairs.merge_caution: No review or meta-analysis was executed during this source review. Preserve all methods and requested-scope choice; user authorization and actual available tools govern execution.

limits: This review used the complete supplied eight entrypoints and shared integration contract already read; each assigned directory contains only SKILL.md.
Linked family specialists are handoff references; this comparison does not pretend to independently review their bodies or validate scientific standards/current provider behavior.
Recommendations are provisional and do not authorize collection mutation before root's all-118 full-read gate.
